interpretation.question: Show a network of sponsors and drugs for pembrolizumab trials

search_semantics.drug: Exact intervention name: filter.advanced AREA[InterventionName]"<drug>" matches the listed intervention names (with the API's concept expansion of aliases), not titles or descriptions.

assumptions: The plan was drafted from the question by the LLM (gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 via openai) and validated; meta.interpretation.draft holds the draft. Counts come from the registry.
Served from the local cache stored at 2026-10-18 17:05 UTC.
Sponsors are lead sponsors only; collaborators are not included.
Intervention MeSH terms are study-level and include non-drug interventions (e.g. radiation, procedures).

Node type 'drug' marks an intervention MeSH term: the API does not link MeSH terms to intervention types (DRUG, RADIATION, PROCEDURE, ...), so non-drug therapies such as radiotherapy keep type 'drug' rather than a guessed type.

Intervention MeSH terms on the registry deny-list (comparators without active treatment, and derived terms that are not interventions) are not drawn as nodes: Standard of Care (D059039, comparator): 8 trials; Observation (D019370, comparator): 10 trials; Watchful Waiting (D057832, comparator): 7 trials; Saline Solution (D000077330, comparator): 18 trials; Taxes (D013660, mesh_mismapping): 48 trials; Single Person (D012847, mesh_mismapping): 4 trials; Automobiles (D001336, mesh_mismapping): 1 trial; Congresses as Topic (D003226, mesh_mismapping): 3 trials; Solutions (D012996, mesh_mismapping): 4 trials. 92 trials affected; their other values are kept.
Node size is the number of trials an entity appears in; a trial counts toward every entity it lists, so node sizes can add up to more than the number of trials.
warnings: 42 of 2575 trials have no lead sponsor or no intervention MeSH term and contribute no edges.

Network trimmed for readability: showing 50 of 1631 nodes (highest weighted degree, cap MAX_NETWORK_NODES=50) and 201 of 4465 edges; 3579 edges below MIN_EDGE_WEIGHT=2 trials and 685 edges to omitted nodes are not shown. 1673 trials with co-occurrences contribute no shown edge, and 52 trials appear in no shown node. Node sizes still count every trial.
